sentences.text: The run proposes a price of $27,454,337 for 987 loans, an assumption for a person to review and not an offer.
It proposes to exclude 8 loans with balance $319,000 and to hold out 5 more loans with balance $212,346 until a person answers; no person has decided yet.
The run found 8 loans at SUMMIT RIDGE AUTO (ring-1) that are still joined by 10 links nobody has taken down.
L0709, L0859 and L0905 failed identity checks, and the other five ring-1 loans have strong unexplained links to failed-identity loans.
SUMMIT RIDGE AUTO has 8 flagged loans, 22.6% of its $1,412,327 book.
The run found ring-2 at CEDAR VALLEY AUTO: L0003, L0047, L0349 and L0984, balance $167,704, still joined by 5 links nobody has taken down.
L0396 and L0706 are proposed for Reprice, with identity verified and no strong unexplained link.
The 5 held-out loans are not verified either way: L0003, L0047, L0349, L0984 and L0528.
For L0528, the bureaus disagree, and the run's status is Insufficient evidence.
The run investigated only 23 of 1000 loans, and the other 977 are priced at base.
Total principal is $29,135,564, and the balance under review is $531,346.
The investigation used 59 acorns of a 60-acorn budget.
Checking all 20 case loans with all four CRS tools would cost 240 acorns, which is 181 more than the run spent.
